newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING ups call warrant issues for Oce, NBM Amstelland.
newsitem.headline: ING ups call warrant issues for Oce, NBM Amstelland.

text.p: ING Bank said on Wednesday it had raised the number of call warrants on ordinary shares of printer and copier maker Oce van der Grinten by 250,000 to 750,000 due to major demand.
ING previously increased the issue in July.

Until June 25, 1998, one call warrant plus a payment of 190 guilders in cash entitles the owner to one Oce van der Grinten share. The warrants will be listed on the Amsterdam Stock Exchange, with trading set to start on July 9.
ING said it was also issuing additional call warrants on convertible preference shares in builder NBM Amstelland for a second time.
"Due to overwhelming demand ING Bank will raise the earlier issue of 2 million call warrants to 2.5 million," it said.
Exercisable on 17 February 1999, one warrant entitles the bearer to one NBM Amstelland convertible preference share of four guilders nominal at a payment of 47 guilders.
The warrants have been traded on the Amsterdam bourse since March 6, 1997.
